title: Feed request failed
description: The departures request failed outright (not just stale): the card shows an explicit error message in --color-error with a small centered glyph, visually distinct from the neutral empty/loading states so operators can tell 'nothing scheduled' apart from 'something broke'.

changes.intent: Distinguish a hard fetch failure from the neutral no-departures/loading empty states.
changes.detail: When the departures fetch fails (e.g. network error, non-2xx response) after retries are exhausted, render `.screen__empty.screen__empty--error` in place of `.arrival-list`, containing a small glyph (e.g. '⚠') followed by the message 'No se pudo cargar la información de salidas.'

changes.intent: Use the error token for both the glyph and message so the failure state is immediately legible, per the color rule (error = failure only).
Give the error glyph slight visual weight above the message text without overpowering the card.
